leadText:
Kiley (Japanese: カイリ Kairi) is a character of the day who appeared in On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!. He is a pro surfer from Lilycove City and a friend of Chrysa who went to the same university as her.

Kiley and his participated in the adult division of the Marine Athletic Race and won. After getting in contact with Chrysa, he met up with , Goh, and Chloe when they arrived in Lilycove City. Kiley showed them around the course and watched the next day as they competed in the kids division of the Marine Athletic Race with their , , and .

When Chloe became trapped in a rock with Eevee and Dewgong having been attacked by a , Kiley came to her aid with Vaporeon and Huntail was soon defeated. Afterwards, Kiley gave Chloe a Water Stone so that she could evolve Eevee. Although Eevee did not want to evolve at that moment, Chloe decided to keep the Water Stone for potential future use.

He reappeared in flashbacks in Reuniting for the First Time! and Infinite Possibilities!.

In Heroes Unite!, Kiley reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met.
